sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Civil Secrt. Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pramod Kumar Singh,Manoj Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Pramod Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Puneet Kumar Yadav,
the learned State Counsel and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
402 of 2023, under Sections 140, 170, 171, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Sushant Golf City, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 04.08.2023 against six persons, including the applicant, alleging that on the basis of information received from a mukhbir that a gang was active by duping people in the name of getting them employed, co-accused Chandra Sen and the applicant were apprehended.
Some fake documents and Rs. 650/- are said to be recovered from the accused Chandra Sen and some fake documents and Rs. 560/- are said to be recovered from the applicant.

sentences.text:
In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
7. Co-accused Chandra Sen has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 04.12.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14074 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14074 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant himself claims to have duped people in the name of getting employment; he has been implicated solely on the basis of his confessional statement and the recovery of documents allegedly made by him has not been witnessed by any independent person and no person has lodged any FIR against the applicant that he has duped any person and coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 04.08.2023 and co-accused Chandra Sen has already been granted bail and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid case.
9.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant-Vijendra Prabhakar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Pradeep/-
